ValidationRule.description: Agency Winback opportunities cannot be closed won if the account cancellation date is less than 30 Days ago. Excludes Admins, EverQuote Manager, and Account Management Standard profiles
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/* When Agency record type Opportunity has Stage "Closed Won" and Type "Winback", return error if the Opportunity Closed Date is less than 30 days from the Pro Account Cancelled Date on the Account */
AND( RecordTypeId = "0121a000000EqqS", /*Agency record type*/ NOT( $Profile.Id = '00e1a000000lWln'), /*Not System Admin*/ NOT( $Profile.Id = '00e1a000000i0iR'), /*Not Account Management Standard Profile*/ NOT( $Profile.Id = '00e1a000000hycc'), /*Not EverQuote - Manager Profile*/ CloseDate-Account.Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c < 30, NOT(ISBLANK(Account.Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c )), ISCHANGED( StageName), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL( Type, "Winback") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A winback opportunity cannot be closed won by Sales within 30 days of the Agency's cancellation date. Questions can be directed to a Sales Manager.
